traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills crowded, narrow; cream to pale yellow when young, becoming ochre-brown with maturity, sometimes with olive tones; edges often whitish
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills crowded, narrow; cream to pale yellow when young, becoming ochre-brown with maturity, sometimes with olive tones; edges often whitish

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Hemispherical to convex when young, later broadly convex to nearly flat, with a low umbo; sticky to viscid when moist; cream-yellow, straw-yellow to pale ochre with olive-greenish tints; margin fringed with veil remnants
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Hemispherical to convex when young, later broadly convex to nearly flat, with a low umbo; sticky to viscid when moist; cream-yellow, straw-yellow to pale ochre with olive-greenish tints; margin fringed with veil remnants

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnate to slightly decurrent
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnate to slightly decurrent

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, cream to pale yellowish, becoming brownish toward base; finely pruinose near apex, covered with whitish to yellow-brown fibrils or small scales below; partial veil leaving a fragile ring or indistinct ring zone
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, cream to pale yellowish, becoming brownish toward base; finely pruinose near apex, covered with whitish to yellow-brown fibrils or small scales below; partial veil leaving a fragile ring or indistinct ring zone

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore print brown to rusty-brown
traits.raw: 🟤🟠 Spore print brown to rusty-brown

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Saprobic on decaying hardwood, especially buried roots, stumps and woody debris; in grass, parks, gardens and woodland paths; solitary, scattered or clustered; summer to late autumn
traits.raw: 🌳🪵🍂 Saprobic on decaying hardwood, especially buried roots, stumps and woody debris; in grass, parks, gardens and woodland paths; solitary, scattered or clustered; summer to late autumn

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Not recommended; little culinary value
traits.raw: 😒 Not recommended; little culinary value

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body small to medium; stipe ~3–10 cm long and ~0.5–1 cm thick
traits.raw: 📏 Fruit body small to medium; stipe ~3–10 cm long and ~0.5–1 cm thick

traits.label: Dimensions
traits.text: Cap ∅ ~2–8 cm
traits.raw: 📐 Cap ∅ ~2–8 cm

traits.label: Flesh
traits.text: Whitish to pale yellowish, thin, unchanging when cut
traits.raw: 🔪 Whitish to pale yellowish, thin, unchanging when cut

traits.label: Chemical reactions
traits.text: No macroscopic reagents reaction
traits.raw: 🧪 No macroscopic reagents reaction

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Slightly sweetish, mushroomy
traits.raw: 👃 Slightly sweetish, mushroomy

traits.label: Taste
traits.text: Indistinct
traits.raw: 👅 Indistinct

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores ellipsoid to oblong or slightly bean-shaped, smooth, yellow-brown, ~5.5–8 × 3.5–4.5 µm; basidia predominantly 4-spored; cheilocystidia cylindrical to lageniform; pileipellis an ixocutis
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores ellipsoid to oblong or slightly bean-shaped, smooth, yellow-brown, ~5.5–8 × 3.5–4.5 µm; basidia predominantly 4-spored; cheilocystidia cylindrical to lageniform; pileipellis an ixocutis

traits.text: Pale yellow sticky scalycap with darker appressed scales, often growing from buried hardwood
